title: IBM Acquires Logiq Consulting to Expand Secure Digital Transformation and Cybersecurity Capabilities in the UK
summary: IBM UK announced the acquisition of Logiq Consulting, an NCSC-assured UK cybersecurity consultancy with deep expertise in highly regulated environments including the UK Defence Industry, UK Critical National Infrastructure and the wider Public Sector.
body_markdown:
**London UK, September 24, 2026,** — IBM (NYSE:[IBM](http://www.ibm.com/investor) ) UK today announced the acquisition of Logiq Consulting, an NCSC-assured UK cybersecurity consultancy with deep expertise in highly regulated environments including the UK Defence Industry, UK Critical National Infrastructure and the wider Public Sector.


Logiq Consulting brings specialist capabilities spanning cybersecurity assurance, Secure by Design, secure systems engineering, digital transformation and secure managed services, helping organisations embed security from the outset and deliver resilient technology in complex operating environments.


Logiq Consulting extends IBM’s cybersecurity transformation portfolio and adds complementary capabilities to SiXworks’ (an IBM Company) digital transformation expertise in Defence and the Public Sector. The acquisition advances IBM’s broader hybrid cloud, AI and digital sovereignty agenda. Together, IBM and Logiq Consulting will help UK clients maintain control over critical data and technology environments, meet evolving security and regulatory requirements, and adopt AI securely, with confidence.


"Cybersecurity, governance and resilience are absolutely critical to organisations as they increasingly accelerate their transformation and adopt AI at scale," said **Rhodri Arrowsmith, Managing Partner for IBM Consulting in UK & Ireland** . "Logiq Consulting brings highly specialised expertise in Secure by Design and cybersecurity assurance that complements our existing capabilities and supports our ability to help clients across the UK's most security-conscious sectors transform with confidence."


"Protecting mission-critical systems has never been more important," said **Mark Hughes, Global Managing Partner for IBM Consulting Cybersecurity Services** . "This acquisition strengthens our ability to help clients manage risk, protect critical services and navigate an increasingly complex threat landscape."


Logiq Consulting has recognised expertise in developing and applying Secure by Design approaches across the UK public and defence sectors, helping organisations build security into every stage of the technology lifecycle. The business also developed and operates DISX®, a managed, sovereign collaboration platform that enables government suppliers to securely exchange sensitive information with UK Government and Defence organisations while maintaining control over where and how that information is managed.


"This marks an exciting new chapter for Logiq Consulting," said **James Morgan, CEO of Logiq Consulting** . "Our success has been built on exceptional people, trusted customer relationships and a relentless focus on solving some of the UK's most complex cyber and security challenges. Our expertise in Defence and Critical National Infrastructure together with IBM's global scale, AI and hybrid cloud capabilities, will enable us to deliver even greater value to our customers and help strengthen the security and resilience of the critical systems and services that underpin modern society. IBM shares our commitment to innovation, excellence and customer success, and I am excited about the opportunities this creates for our people, our clients and the future of our business."


Financial details of the transaction were not disclosed.


**About Logiq Consulting**


Logiq Consulting is a UK-based cybersecurity consultancy and secure solutions provider operating across Defence, Government, Critical National Infrastructure and regulated sectors. The company specialises in cybersecurity assurance, Secure by Design, secure systems engineering, digital transformation and managed services, helping organisations deliver secure outcomes in complex operating environments.


**About IBM**


IBM is a leading provider of global hybrid cloud and AI, and consulting expertise. We help clients in more than 175 countries capitalise on insights from their data, streamline business processes, reduce costs and gain the competitive edge in their industries. Thousands of government and corporate entities in critical infrastructure areas such as financial services, telecommunications and healthcare rely on IBM's hybrid cloud platform and Red Hat OpenShift to affect their digital transformations quickly, efficiently and securely. IBM's breakthrough innovations in AI, quantum computing, industry-specific cloud solutions and consulting deliver open and flexible options to our clients.
